package idlesim

// Advance 积分 [LastAt, min(now,Horizon))：双倍结束点前后分段，整数工作量保留余数。
// 每个工坊独享同一时间预算；一个工坊最多处理四个在途任务，不按离线秒数循环追 tick。
func (s *State) Advance(now int64) error {
	if !validTime(now) || now < s.LastAt {
		return ErrRule
	}
	end := min(now, s.Horizon)
	if end > s.LastAt {
		work := end - s.LastAt
		if s.BoostUntil > s.LastAt {
			work += max(int64(0), min(end, s.BoostUntil)-s.LastAt)
		}
		income := s.IncomeRemainder + work*s.IncomeLevel
		s.Pending = min(s.Rules.PendingCap, s.Pending+income/s.Rules.IncomePeriod)
		s.IncomeRemainder = income % s.Rules.IncomePeriod
		// 收益箱满时不保留溢出和小数尾巴，领取后从下一段实际时间重新累计。
		if s.Pending == s.Rules.PendingCap {
			s.IncomeRemainder = 0
		}
		for index := range s.Stations {
			station := &s.Stations[index]
			budget := work
			for len(station.Queue) > 0 && len(station.Ready) < QueueLimit && budget > 0 {
				job := &station.Queue[0]
				used := min(budget, job.Required-job.Progress)
				job.Progress += used
				budget -= used
				if job.Progress < job.Required {
					break
				}
				station.Ready = append(station.Ready, *job)
				station.Queue = station.Queue[1:]
			}
		}
	}
	s.LastAt = now
	return nil
}
func (s State) NextDeadline() int64 {
	if s.Horizon <= s.LastAt {
		return 0
	}
	return min(s.Horizon, s.LastAt+s.Rules.TickMillis)
}
func (s *State) Apply(c Command, now int64) (Receipt, error) {
	if c.Seq == 0 {
		return Receipt{}, ErrRule
	}
	if c.Seq <= uint64(len(s.Receipts)) {
		r := s.Receipts[c.Seq-1]
		if r.Command != c {
			return Receipt{}, ErrRule
		}
		return r, nil
	}
	if c.Seq != uint64(len(s.Receipts))+1 || len(s.Receipts) >= LedgerLimit || !validTime(now+s.Rules.OfflineCap) {
		return Receipt{}, ErrRule
	}
	// 调用者只能使用 DAO 解码的局部副本，任何失败都丢弃本次 Advance 与操作，不写回。
	if err := s.Advance(now); err != nil {
		return Receipt{}, err
	}
	switch c.Kind {
	case "queue":
		if c.Station < 0 || c.Station >= 3 || c.Recipe < 0 || c.Recipe >= 3 {
			return Receipt{}, ErrRule
		}
		station := &s.Stations[c.Station]
		recipe := s.Rules.Recipes[c.Recipe]
		if len(station.Queue) >= QueueLimit || s.Raw < recipe.Raw {
			return Receipt{}, ErrRule
		}
		s.Raw -= recipe.Raw
		station.Queue = append(station.Queue, Job{ID: c.Seq, Recipe: c.Recipe, Required: (recipe.Work + station.Level - 1) / station.Level, Raw: recipe.Raw, Output: recipe.Output})
	case "cancel":
		if c.Station < 0 || c.Station >= 3 {
			return Receipt{}, ErrRule
		}
		station := &s.Stations[c.Station]
		found := -1
		for i, j := range station.Queue {
			if j.ID == c.JobID {
				found = i
				break
			}
		}
		if found < 0 || station.Queue[found].Progress != 0 || s.Raw > s.Rules.RawCap-station.Queue[found].Raw {
			return Receipt{}, ErrRule
		}
		s.Raw += station.Queue[found].Raw
		station.Queue = append(station.Queue[:found], station.Queue[found+1:]...)
	case "collect":
		if c.Station < 0 || c.Station >= 3 {
			return Receipt{}, ErrRule
		}
		station := &s.Stations[c.Station]
		if len(station.Ready) == 0 {
			return Receipt{}, ErrRule
		}
		total := int64(0)
		for _, v := range s.Inventory {
			total += v
		}
		for _, j := range station.Ready {
			total += j.Output
		}
		if total > s.Rules.WarehouseCap {
			return Receipt{}, ErrRule
		}
		for _, j := range station.Ready {
			s.Inventory[j.Recipe] += j.Output
		}
		station.Ready = nil
	case "sell":
		if c.Recipe < 0 || c.Recipe >= 3 || c.Count < 1 || c.Count > 100 || s.Inventory[c.Recipe] < c.Count {
			return Receipt{}, ErrRule
		}
		value := c.Count * s.Rules.Recipes[c.Recipe].Price
		if s.Gold > ValueLimit-value {
			return Receipt{}, ErrRule
		}
		s.Inventory[c.Recipe] -= c.Count
		s.Gold += value
	case "buy":
		if c.Count < 1 || c.Count > 20 || s.Gold < c.Count*2 || s.Raw > s.Rules.RawCap-c.Count {
			return Receipt{}, ErrRule
		}
		s.Gold -= c.Count * 2
		s.Raw += c.Count
	case "upgrade":
		if c.Station < 0 || c.Station >= 3 {
			return Receipt{}, ErrRule
		}
		station := &s.Stations[c.Station]
		if len(station.Queue) != 0 || station.Level >= 5 || s.Gold < 10*station.Level {
			return Receipt{}, ErrRule
		}
		s.Gold -= 10 * station.Level
		station.Level++
	case "income_upgrade":
		if s.IncomeLevel >= 5 || s.Gold < 10*s.IncomeLevel {
			return Receipt{}, ErrRule
		}
		s.Gold -= 10 * s.IncomeLevel
		s.IncomeLevel++
	case "boost":
		if s.BoostUntil > now || s.Gems < 2 || !validTime(now+s.Rules.BoostMillis) {
			return Receipt{}, ErrRule
		}
		s.Gems -= 2
		s.BoostUntil = now + s.Rules.BoostMillis
	case "claim":
		if s.Pending == 0 || s.Gold > ValueLimit-s.Pending {
			return Receipt{}, ErrRule
		}
		s.Gold += s.Pending
		s.Pending = 0
	case "daily":
		day := now / DayMillis
		if s.DailyDay >= day || s.Gold > ValueLimit-5 {
			return Receipt{}, ErrRule
		}
		s.Gold += 5
		s.DailyDay = day
	case "order":
		if s.Inventory[0] < 2 || s.Inventory[1] < 1 || s.Gold > ValueLimit-20 || s.Orders >= ValueLimit {
			return Receipt{}, ErrRule
		}
		s.Inventory[0] -= 2
		s.Inventory[1]--
		s.Gold += 20
		s.Orders++
	case "settle":
	default:
		return Receipt{}, ErrRule
	}
	s.Horizon = now + s.Rules.OfflineCap
	r := Receipt{c, now, s.Gold, s.Raw, s.Pending, s.ConfigHash}
	s.Receipts = append(s.Receipts, r)
	return r, nil
}
